column1: # demo  verified_ticks  canonical_registered_state_fnv1a
# Regenerated 2026-08-10, for a real simulation change: a trailing large sidekick fires from
# SIDEKICK_TRAIL_SHOT_Y below its position, and all three demos fly a Companion Ship Gerund in the
# left slot, so its shots start seven pixels lower and connect on different ticks. Verified to be
# that change alone by building with the constant at 0, every other edit kept: all three hashes came
# back at the previous line's values. Confirmed not to be a local config artifact: the three hashes
# below come back identically from a working directory with no opentyrian.cfg in it.
# Regenerated 2026-08-10, for a real simulation change: Shot Hitboxes defaults to Centered, which
# moves the point both shot loops collide a projectile from, so shots in the demos connect on
# different ticks. Confirmed to be the default and not a local config artifact: the three hashes
# below come back identically with no opentyrian.cfg present at all and with a full one whose only
# difference is the new key, so nothing else in a saved config is moving them.
# Regenerated 2026-08-07, for two snapshot-shape changes with no simulation change behind them:
#  - the Soul-of-Zinglon pillar render request (zinglonPillarActive/CX/Temp) became one per ship,
#    so three registry scalars became three two-element arrays. Verified by registering only
#    element [0] of each under its old name and size, every other change kept: all three hashes
#    and the layout hash came back identical to the previous line.
#  - JE_SingleEnemyType gained homeTarget (endless co-op homing). It lands in existing padding, so
#    sizeof and the layout hash do not move, but the fields after it shift a byte and demo 1's
#    hashed state moves with them. Verified by building with the field declared and never
#    assigned: demo 1 still hashes dbd7383e, so the shift alone accounts for it.
